object.attr: derived: review Q1, merged with CHECK's requirement (CF-C43, CF-C44, CF-C45, D-C18). With `paths` holding only the manifest, the working copy passes while the commit names objects whose files stay uncommitted. Replaces the draft's "validate the working copy" (open question Q5). MELLON-CHECK-SRS-7 covers the Validate action.
object.description: When Mellon validates a document before a commit, Mellon shall validate the document as the commit is to hold the document: the latest commit's files, with the selected paths' working-copy content in place.
